stem: What is one way that Rodriguez’s and Jonkers’ methods were similar?

options.label: A
options.text: They both created mixtures using living materials.

options.label: B
options.text: They both traveled to an unfamiliar location to begin their research.

options.label: C
options.text: They both studied particular animals to inform their research.

options.label: D
options.text: They both considered how temperature might affect their results.
